title: Increment and Decrement
learningObjectives: Explain increment and decrement in C++.
Identify the operators, operands and result types involved.
Predict an expression's result by tracing it.
Use the topic in a focused program.
Avoid common mistakes and choose a clear alternative.

understand.concept: ++ increments and -- decrements. Prefix changes the value before yielding it; postfix yields the old value before the change. Avoid combining these in dense expressions.
understand.whyItMatters: Accurate expression understanding prevents logic errors and improves safety, readability and maintainability.
understand.explain: Study increment and decrement through the rule summary and examples; trace values carefully and note type and edge-case constraints.

practise.guidedTask: Trace all five examples for increment and decrement. Predict the result first, then modify an operand and explain the change.
practise.independentTask: Create a short C++ program applying increment and decrement to a practical problem. Include three test cases and one boundary case, and explain your choices.
